list.name: pc_id
list.label: PC
list.query: SELECT pc_id FROM pc_info ORDER BY pc_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT (COALESCE( a.scores->'panel', jsonb_build_object( 'id', p.pc_id, 'online', true, 'score', COALESCE((a.scores->>'final')::float,0), 'cpu',0,'gpu',0,'mem',0, 'scoreSpark', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(s ORDER BY dt) FROM (SELECT (a2.scores->>'final')::float s, a2.detected_at dt FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a2 WHERE a2.pc_id=p.pc_id ORDER BY a2.detected_at DESC LIMIT 30) z), '[]'::jsonb), 'risk', jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object('axis','채굴','value', least(1.0,COALESCE((a.scores->'risk_vector'->>'mining')::float,0)/10.0)), jsonb_build_object('axis','오작동','value', least(1.0,COALESCE((a.scores->'risk_vector'->>'malfunction')::float,0)/10.0)), jsonb_build_object('axis','노후화','value', least(1.0,COALESCE((a.scores->'risk_vector'->>'aging')::float,0)/10.0)), jsonb_build_object('axis','위협','value', least(1.0,COALESCE((a.scores->'risk_vector'->>'threat')::float,0)/10.0)), jsonb_build_object('axis','망 남용','value', least(1.0,COALESCE((a.scores->'risk_vector'->>'network_abuse')::float,0)/10.0)) ), 'composition', cmp.arr, 'ai', jsonb_build_object( 'grade', COALESCE(j.judgment, a.anomaly_type), 'sev', CASE a.severity WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 'mock', COALESCE(j.is_mock,true), 'fast', (a.scores->'evidence_meta'->>'fast_path_match') IS NOT NULL, 'primaryType', COALESCE(a.scores->'risk_vector'->>'primary_type','—'), 'at', to_char(a.detected_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'reason', COALESCE(j.reason, j.details->>'reason',''), 'signals', COALESCE(a.scores->'evidence_meta'->'active_signals','[]'::jsonb), 'quality', jsonb_build_object('level',COALESCE(a.scores->'signal_quality'->>'overall','FULL'),'degraded',COALESCE((a.scores->'signal_quality'->'degraded_sources')::text,'없음')), 'explain', jsonb_build_object('level',COALESCE(a.scores->'explanation_confidence'->>'level','MED'),'basis',COALESCE((a.scores->'explanation_confidence'->'reasons')::text,'')), 'freshness', jsonb_build_object('missing','-','delay','-','lastSeen','-'), 'benign', COALESCE(j.details->>'benign_confidence',''), 'contradicting', COALESCE(j.details->>'contradicting_mining_evidence',''), 'action', COALESCE(j.action, j.details->>'action','') ) ) ))::text AS panel FROM pc_monitor.pc_info p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a0.scores, a0.severity, a0.anomaly_type, a0.detected_at, a0.id FROM pc_monitor.anomaly_history a0 WHERE a0.pc_id=p.pc_id ORDER BY a0.detected_at DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true LEFT JOIN pc_monitor.ai_judgment_history j ON j.anomaly_id=a.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object('k','리소스','flat','#7c5cff','pct',CASE WHEN tot>0 THEN round(r/tot*100) ELSE 0 END), jsonb_build_object('k','프로세스','flat','#ec4899','pct',CASE WHEN tot>0 THEN round(p/tot*100) ELSE 0 END), jsonb_build_object('k','ML','flat','#f59e0b','pct',CASE WHEN tot>0 THEN round(m/tot*100) ELSE 0 END), jsonb_build_object('k','에피소드','flat','#06b6d4','pct',CASE WHEN tot>0 THEN round(e/tot*100) ELSE 0 END), jsonb_build_object('k','상관','flat','#84cc16','pct',CASE WHEN tot>0 THEN round(c/tot*100) ELSE 0 END), jsonb_build_object('k','네트워크','flat','#3b82f6','pct',CASE WHEN tot>0 THEN round(n/tot*100) ELSE 0 END) ) AS arr FROM (SELECT COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'resource')::numeric,0) r, COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'process')::numeric,0) p, COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'ml')::numeric,0) m, COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'episode')::numeric,0) e, COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'correlation')::numeric,0) c, COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'network')::numeric,0) n, COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'resource')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'process')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'ml')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'episode')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'correlation')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((a.scores->'score_breakdown'->>'network')::numeric,0) tot ) bd ) cmp ON true WHERE p.pc_id = '$pc_id' LIMIT 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, cpu_percent AS cpu, mem_percent AS mem, gpu_percent AS gpu, (vram_mb/8192.0*100) AS vram, inbound_mb AS neti, outbound_mb AS neto, disk_write_mb AS disk FROM metrics_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at
